primary_sources.citation: Newson et al., Realistic Film Grain Rendering, IPOL 2017

primary_sources.role: circular scanner aperture equation and measured diameter

question: Does physically ordered presampling integration of colour dye-cloud transmittance through a circular scanner aperture admit a bounded 8x reference approximation at 4000 dpi that materially outperforms post-raster circular and Gaussian controls?

material.target_density_fixture: fixed smooth ramp plus checker and sparse step components in three dye-density layers

operators.candidate: render dye density at 8x physical lattice, convert D to T=10^-D, integrate the circular aperture, then sample exact target-cell centres
operators.reference: same frozen marked-Poisson geometry at 16x physical lattice with the same D-to-T-before-aperture ordering
operators.wrong_order_control: integrate dye density through the 8x aperture, sample, then convert D to T
operators.post_raster_circular_control: sample unfiltered 8x transmittance then apply the frozen failed P6AB 3x3 disk-area kernel
operators.post_raster_gaussian_control: sample unfiltered 8x transmittance then apply an equal-second-moment Gaussian at target pitch

metrics: candidate RMSE and P95 absolute error versus 16x reference
RMSE improvement versus best post-raster control
RMSE improvement versus wrong density-order control
constant, finite-range, repeat and row-partition invariants

forbidden: change zooms, density fixture, cloud radii/marks, aperture, controls or gates after scoring
reuse the 16x reference inside the candidate path
fit a correction, alter support or tune the random realization
treat the Ansel engineering implementation as a complete colour-film chemical model
modify a production profile, native runtime or product default
claim measured scanner, stock, process or photographic calibration

branch_rule.pass: Retain presampling D-to-T aperture integration as an offline physical reference and next test a bounded target-resolution compiler distinct from post-raster convolution.
branch_rule.fail: Close the 8x approximation unchanged; retain the 16x reference only if its physical invariants pass, otherwise close this synthetic family.

claim_ceiling: Generic synthetic colour dye-cloud plus scanner-aperture ordering evidence; no measured film, scanner, stock, process, quality or product claim.
